message: We use first-party storage to make the site work and, if you allow it, to remember your country and which campaign brought you here. We don't use third-party analytics; only if you accept measurement does the confirmation page load the Google Ads conversion tag.

preferences.title: Cookie preferences
preferences.description: Choose what we may store in your browser. You can change this decision at any time from the footer.
preferences.noDecision: You haven't decided yet: until then only the necessary ones are used.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: Essential: keeping you signed in if you log in, remembering this very choice, and carrying what you configured in the estimator over to the contact form. They can't be turned off.

preferences.label: Preferences
preferences.description: Store your country so we can suggest a default currency and phone prefix without looking it up on every visit.

measurement.label: Measurement
measurement.description: Store which campaign or page you came from (UTM parameters, ad click identifiers) so it can be attached if you write to us. This site does not send it to advertising networks.
